name: synergos-ui
description: Synergos UI — Multi-framework Web Components workspace

scripts.build: npm run build:angular && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:react && npm run build:svelte && npm run build:vanilla
scripts.build:experiences: npm run --prefix platforms/angular build:experiences && npm run build:react && npm run build:svelte && npm run build:vanilla
scripts.test: npm run test:angular && npm run test:react && npm run test:svelte && npm run test:vanilla
scripts.lint: npm run lint:angular && npm run lint:react && npm run lint:svelte && npm run lint:vanilla
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run contracts:validate && npm run publish:runtime && node tools/publish.mjs --verify --clean
scripts.release:angular: npm run build:angular && npm run build:runtime && npm run contracts:validate && npm run publish:runtime && node tools/publish.mjs --framework angular --verify --clean
scripts.release:react: npm run build:react   && npm run contracts:validate && node tools/publish.mjs --framework react    --verify --clean
scripts.release:svelte: npm run build:svelte  && npm run contracts:validate && node tools/publish.mjs --framework svelte   --verify --clean
scripts.release:vanilla: npm run build:vanilla && npm run contracts:validate && node tools/publish.mjs --framework vanilla  --verify --clean
scripts.contracts:validate: npm run element:audit && npm run manifest:validate
scripts.setup: npm run setup:angular && npm run setup:react && npm run setup:svelte && npm run setup:vanilla
